facts.fact: Burkina 24 reports that the Referentiel general d'interoperabilite (RGI), a normative document fixing the rules that make the information systems of the different public administrations compatible, was adopted by an order (arrete) of the Prime Minister dated 23 May 2018, and was the subject of a training seminar for IT directorates on 15-17 October 2019; it is an arrete, not an act or decree, and some of its communication protocols are described as mandatory and others as recommended.

note: The article does not say the order obliges public bodies to exchange data, so no duty fact; it says only that some protocols are mandatory.
